title: A Star Out of Jacob
old_p1: Long ago, a man named Balaam saw far into the future. He said, “There shall come a Star out of Jacob.”
Jacob’s family was Israel. Stars help travelers find the way. Prophets, who speak for Heavenly Father, teach that this Star is Jesus!
When Jesus was born, wise men in the east saw His star. They came a long way to find the new King.
old_p2: The star went before them and stopped over the house where young Jesus was. They were full of joy! They knelt and worshiped Him, which means they loved and honored Him. They gave Him gold and sweet-smelling frankincense and myrrh.
Tonight, picture that bright star. You can find Jesus too, by learning about Him and following Him.
p1: Long ago, Heavenly Father helped a man named Balaam see far ahead. Balaam said, “There shall come a Star out of Jacob.”
Jacob’s family was Israel, Heavenly Father’s people. A star shows travelers the way. Balaam was talking about Jesus!
When Jesus was born, wise men in the east saw His star. They came a long way to find the new King.
p2: The star went ahead and stopped over the house where young Jesus was. The wise men were so full of joy! They knelt and worshiped Him. They gave Him gold and sweet-smelling frankincense and myrrh.
They kept following, and they found Jesus. Tonight, picture that bright star. You can keep looking for Jesus too, by learning about Him.
